source_text: Elective circumcision is advised for individuals with recurrent paraphimosis or persistent phimosis unresponsive to conservative treatments, eliminating the foreskin and thereby preventing future episodes in high-risk groups such as those with balanitis xerotica obliterans or cultural predispositions to delayed intervention. [43]
